5.0.SP2.description: Specific date of trade settlement (SettlementDate) in YYYYMMDD format. If present, this field overrides SettlType <63> . This field is required if the value of SettlType <63> is "6" (Future) or "8" (Sellers Option). This field must be omitted if the value of SettlType <63> is "7" (When and If Issued) (expressed in local time at place of settlement)
